title: ChatWeave Action (draft 0.1)
description: DRAFT. Action protocol v1: the action spec declared inside an interactive block (server-authored), the action request sent by the client, and the action result returned by the server. Producers validate strictly; consumers parse leniently and ignore unknown fields.

actionId.description: Client-generated unique id; doubles as the idempotency key. UUIDv7 recommended.

actionType.description: v1 controlled action types. Phase 3 will add more (e.g. item.open, filter.apply).

target.description: Name of the host-registered handler in the server-side Action Registry, e.g. 'clarification.answer'. Opaque to the library.

actionSpec.description: Declared by the server inside a choice / confirmation / form_intent block. The client never invents an action spec; it can only reference the one persisted in the block.

requiresConfirmation.description: True for destructive or irreversible operations. Such actions may only be declared on a confirmation block with severity 'destructive'. The server registry enforces this independently.

actionContext.description: Ids that locate the block the action belongs to. Everything else (user, tenant, permissions) is derived server-side by the host and never trusted from the client.

choiceSelectPayload.$comment: Free-text answers to a choice are sent as normal user messages, not through this payload; the host links them to the open block and resolves it server-side.

id.description: Idempotency key. Generated once per user intent on a block; retries after a network error or timeout MUST reuse it (the action may already have run). A new id is only minted when the user makes a new decision after a definitive rejection while the block is still open.

target.description: Echo of the spec's target. The server uses the persisted spec; a mismatch is rejected.

code.description: forbidden: this person may not answer this block. conflict: a business rule refused the operation. already_resolved / expired / superseded: the block is no longer open; the result carries patches with the server's actual state. unavailable: the outcome is unknown (the action may have run); clients must not present it as a failure and should refresh the block state, retrying with the same action id.

message.description: Human-readable, safe to show to the end user. Never contains internal details.

blockPatch.description: Same shape as the block.patch stream event payload, plus messageId. Used to carry block state changes in an action result.

patch.description: JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) applied to the block's {data, fallbackText, metadata}.

status.description: completed: done synchronously. accepted: queued for async work (e.g. a new agent turn). rejected: validation / permission / state failure, do not retry as-is. failed: execution error, see error.retryable.

followUp.description: When the action starts a new assistant message (e.g. the agent resumes after a clarification).

replayed.description: True when the server returned a stored result for a repeated action id.

allOf.$comment: When the block is no longer open, the server returns its actual current state so the client shows the server outcome (e.g. someone else answered first), never the local tap.
